reference: The keeper was standing on his line when the referee pointed to the spot.
sk: Brankár práve stál na čiare, keď rozhodca ukázal na biely bod.
cz: Brankář zrovna stál na čáře, když rozhodčí ukázal na značku.
acceptable: The {keeper|goalkeeper|goalie} was {just |}standing on {his|the} {line|goal line} when the referee pointed {to|at} the {spot|penalty spot}.
When the referee pointed {to|at} the {spot|penalty spot}, the {keeper|goalkeeper|goalie} was {just |}standing on {his|the} {line|goal line}.

mistakes.text: The {keeper|goalkeeper} stood on {his|the} line when the referee pointed to the spot.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pre dej, ktorý práve prebiehal, keď prišla iná udalosť, je lepší Past Continuous: „was standing“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Pro děj, který právě probíhal, když přišla jiná událost, je lepší Past Continuous: „was standing“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For an action in progress when another event happened, Past Continuous is better: “was standing”.

mistakes.text: The {keeper|goalkeeper} was stand on {his|the} line when the referee pointed to the spot.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „was“ v Past Continuous patrí tvar s -ing: „was standing“, nie „was stand“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „was“ v Past Continuous patří tvar s -ing: „was standing“, ne „was stand“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “was” in Past Continuous, use the -ing form: “was standing”, not “was stand”.

mistakes.text: The {keeper|goalkeeper} standing on {his|the} line when the referee pointed to the spot.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Chýba „was“: Past Continuous sa tvorí „was“ + -ing, teda „was standing“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Chybí „was“: Past Continuous se tvoří „was“ + -ing, tedy „was standing“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “was” is missing: Past Continuous is “was” + -ing, so “was standing”.

mistakes.text: The {keeper|goalkeeper} was standing on {his|the} line when the referee was pointing to the spot.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Krátky dej, ktorý preruší prebiehajúci dej, patrí do Past Simple: „pointed“, nie „was pointing“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Krátký děj, který přeruší probíhající děj, patří do Past Simple: „pointed“, ne „was pointing“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The short action that interrupts the longer one takes Past Simple: “pointed”, not “was pointing”.

source_issues: SK/CZ add 'práve/zrovna' (just) and have no possessive 'his'; CZ says 'značku' (the mark) for the penalty spot.
